name: fl-design-system
description: Fission's own design system, end to end: fl-ds-new-project scaffolds a brand-new project in whatever framework the engineer picks (Next.js, React, Vue, Angular, Astro, Svelte, ...), then asks styling from a menu scoped to what that specific framework can actually use — no React-only library (shadcn/ui, MUI, Chakra) offered to Vue/Angular, same as Fission itself. Fission's design system only appears as a directly selectable option on Next.js (fully) or React (partially), never a buried follow-up question. fl-ds-setup then scaffolds or installs/updates it once chosen, and ten component skills (fl-ds-button, fl-ds-input, fl-ds-card, fl-ds-dialog, fl-ds-table, fl-ds-form, fl-ds-badge, fl-ds-select, fl-ds-tabs, fl-ds-toast) each check it's installed before using it, installing it on the spot if not. Fission's own system stays scoped and deliberate — no generic multi-brand component detection.
_schema_note: Verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference (checked 2026-10-09). No 'skills' array: the standard skills/ directory scan already covers all 12 skills here, and an explicit array only adds to that scan, so it would be a redundant hand-maintained duplicate.
